integrity: Complete ordinary proof included. Finite reproducibility checks are corroborative and do not prove asymptotic density or all cases.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to normalized traces with positive integral parameter and discriminant 4(u^2+1); does not classify general Lucas parameters or local realizability prime densities. Priority against undiscovered generalizations is not independently established.
title: Uniform local Dold classification for normalized Pell-type traces
